RELOCATION POLICY
5.1 Purpose
The purpose of this policy is to set forth the conditions of eligibility for relocation benefits and to describe the various types of benefits available to eligible persons displaced by Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Housing Rehabilitation activities.
5.2 Administration
The Central Relocation Office shall be responsible for the administration and assignment of all relocation benefits for displaced persons located in a CDBG project area.
5.3 Applicability, Federal, State, and Local Regulations
It is the City's policy to provide relocation benefits on a uniform basis throughout the City to the extent possible. Therefore, in the CDBG project areas, the assigning of benefits shall be consistent with existing Federal and State rules and guidelines in addition to any local rules and/or policies specific to the CDBG housing rehabilitation program.
5.4 General Eligibility for Relocation Benefits
Persons eligible for benefits are:
a. Persons living in designated residential (CDBG) project areas; and who, because of the nature of the rehabilitation repairs, require temporary housing until completion of all repairs.
b. Persons living in designated residential (CDBG) project areas; and displaced as the result of inspection and declaration of said dwelling as one requiring demolition.
